name: Hip Dislocation
definition: Traumatic displacement of the femoral head from the acetabulum, usually posterior and commonly associated with high-energy trauma.

typical: Inability to move or bear weight

redFlags.item: Any traumatic hip dislocation is an emergency

core: Sciatic nerve and distal vascular exam

investigations.principle: Urgent imaging and reduction are required.
investigations.MRI: CT after reduction is commonly used to assess fractures/congruity; MRI later for soft tissue/AVN when indicated.

amber: Delay in reduction increases risk of osteonecrosis; fracture-dislocation may require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni-sandhi displacement may be documented only after emergency orthopedic management.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic displacement of the femoral head from the acetabulum, usually posterior and commonly associated with high-energy trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
